decisions.rationale: The $40,600 gift letter states the amount will be repaid, is unsigned and has an inconsistent donor name/relationship, and without it the balance is below the $86,500 down payment.
Panel appraiser Valeur Reference Inc. values the property at $867,000 versus $865,000 price, report dated 30 April 2026.
Letter dated 16 May 2026 on letterhead, signed by HR, confirms permanent full-time employment at $87,454, consistent with application.
GDS is roughly 31-34% and TDS roughly 36-38% depending on condo fee and revolving debt treatment, both within 39%/44%, and credit score 716 meets the 600 minimum.
